As you move further, you realize the goal isn't escape. The story is told through sound, silence, and observation, forcing you to doubt your own conclusions. Every step resounds too loudly, every wait drags on, and loneliness becomes an instrument of terror. The important thing here isn't survival, but understanding what it is that wants to be heard.

Features of the game

Psychological horror for one session. Storytelling through sound and environment. A house that reacts to the player's actions. Duration is about 1–2 hours.

22528.description:
Perfume Atelier — is a cozy creativity simulator in which the player manages their own perfume workshop. There's no rush or pressure: just scents, silence, and the process of creating unique compositions. Each bottle is the result of experimentation, careful selection of ingredients, and an understanding of the mood of the future owner.

Alchemy of aromas

The process begins with the selection of essences, each of which influences the character and depth of the fragrance. By combining notes, the artist shapes the mood of the perfume, balancing freshness, warmth, and richness. Mistakes can lead to unexpected results, so it's important to consider the properties of the components and their interactions.

Finished compositions find their way to clients, each with their own expectations and requests. Successful orders bring new recipes, rare ingredients, and opportunities to improve the workshop, gradually transforming the small atelier into a renowned destination for fragrance connoisseurs.

Features of the game

Creating perfumes from many essences. The influence of ingredients on the character of aroma. Clients with individual requests. Development and arrangement of the workshop.

22649.description:
The Case of the Worst Day Ever is a comedy detective puzzle about a family celebration gone wrong. The guests look depressed, the atmosphere is tense, and every character is hiding something. The player must reconstruct the chain of events leading up to the party and understand why the celebration turned into the worst day ever.

Reconstruction of events based on environmental details

Progress is based on careful examination of scenes and comparison of facts. You analyze the behavior of family members, notice inconsistencies, and use the words you find to draw conclusions. Each case requires logical thinking and the ability to establish cause-and-effect relationships.

The difficulty gradually increases, forcing you to delve deeper into the details. A built-in hint system helps you avoid getting stuck, and a notebook records key observations. Despite the investigation, the game maintains a lighthearted atmosphere and presents the events with a touch of humor.

Features of the game

Deductive mechanics with its own conclusions. 10 stories of increasing difficulty. Hints for difficult moments. Warm comedic storytelling style.

22803.description:
Last Mage — is a bullet-heaven roguelite where spells and a backpack are equally important for survival. You are the last mage sent into dungeons overrun with monsters to find the source of a catastrophe. The hordes advance relentlessly, and each run becomes a search for the perfect build to withstand the pressure and clear the path to the truth.

Handcrafted Magic

Spells aren't fixed — they can be enhanced, altering projectile behavior, speeding up reload times, or concentrating damage in narrow streams. Choosing a starting rune sets the direction for development, but further upgrades completely change the feel of combat. Some combos flood the screen with projectiles, while others focus on pinpoint yet devastating strikes.

A backpack isn't just a storage space, it's a strategic element. Items of different shapes occupy space, and their placement affects their effectiveness. Rarity, interactions, and crafting recipes unlock new effects, while accumulated experience triggers powerful reactions. The right configuration turns a mage into the center of a destructive storm.

Features of the game

Two heroes with different starting abilities. Nine basic spells and over 100 upgrades. Four unique battle maps. 50+ items and many crafting recipes.

22924.description:
The Artifactory is a chaotic, co-op game where players work in a frantic factory of magical loot boxes. Resources flow along conveyor belts, machines break down at the most inopportune moments, and time is constantly running out. The team must quickly craft magical items, package the loot, and ship orders before the factory collapses around them.

Magical production

The gameplay revolves around crafting items from strange ingredients. Players brew potions, forge weapons, enchant gear, and combine materials from conveyor belts. Different recipes yield unusual loot, and experimenting with ingredients unlocks new combinations and unexpected results.

Factory malfunctions constantly hamper work. Conveyors can get stuck, items fall into lava, platforms move right underfoot, and portals transport resources to unpredictable locations. All this turns ordinary item assembly into a chaotic race where quick reactions and help are essential.

Features of the game

Single-screen co-op for four players. Create magical loot from various ingredients. Experimenting with recipes and unusual combinations. A crazy factory with traps and malfunctions.

23617.description:
Toll Booth Simulator — is a strange simulation of working at a roadblock, where a normal shift quickly devolves into complete absurdity. At first, everything seems familiar: cars arrive, you press a button, raise the barrier, take the money, and send the driver on his way. But this doesn't last long. Things that shouldn't have anything to do with the road or a checkpoint quickly creep into the routine.

First they pay, then the nonsense begins

You start growing some weird plants right next to the booth. The fruits look like they don't belong in the normal world, but you then mix them into drinks for the people passing by. And instead of paying the usual fare, you're standing there trying to decide what to sell the driver — because the effect of these cocktails can be anything. Some leave satisfied, others... well, maybe not even that much.

The job gradually becomes more than just "raising the barrier." You monitor the flow of cars, choose which ones to let through and which to turn back, tinker with the harvest, experiment with drinks, and simultaneously find ways to extract something valuable. Sometimes this means going where it's best not to. But without taking risks, there will be no progress, and standing still here is impossible.

Features of the game

A mixture of routine and absurdity. Growing unusual plants. Creating drinks with different effects. Risky methods of resource extraction.

23738.description:
Trials Survivors — a survivor-like game with a huge amount of loot, insane synergies, and a screen that quickly devolves into a continuous stream of enemies, effects, and projectiles. The main spell is controlled manually, but everything else is automatic, so your attention is constantly shifting between movement, dodging, and the greedy desire to gather even more power mid-run.

Chaos here becomes a reward for a good build.

Spells, relics, and upgrades easily combine into absurd combinations. Additional projectiles, piercing abilities, chain attacks, and effect boosts gradually transform a character into a walking disaster, capable of cluttering the screen with so many attacks that enemies are sometimes almost invisible behind the flashes. The game makes no attempt to limit the power of builds — on the contrary, it constantly pushes you to build something even more broken.

Constellation Challenges set the pace of the run: in some, you need to survive the onslaught of hordes, in others, you need to quickly eliminate a required number of monsters before the timer runs out. Successful completion unlocks new abilities, relics, and ways to further boost your build. The cat merchant, mountains of loot, and constant power growth make the experience closer to a hack and slash than a classic survivor-like.

Features of the game

Survivor-like with an emphasis on building. Relics and crazy power-up combinations. Hordes of enemies and a huge number of effects. Constellation tests and different archetypes.

24706.description:
Laballatory is a logic game that combines physics experiments, developing combinations, and the gradual exploration of a closed laboratory. Each attempt brings you closer to unraveling its workings, and well-designed chains of interactions allow you to achieve increasingly better results and open up new possibilities for further advancement.

Combinations that change the rules

The focus is on the ball interaction system, where it's not the individual elements that matter, but their combined performance. By experimenting with different combinations, you can significantly increase the effectiveness of your design and earn enough points to unlock subsequent zones. New devices expand the available mechanics, forcing you to explore increasingly unusual strategies and reconsider established solutions.

The laboratory gradually reveals its secrets through exploration of its rooms and the discovery of audio recordings. Each opened door leads to new challenges, requiring careful attention to surrounding objects and an understanding of their operating principles. The further you progress, the more complex the tasks become and the more diverse the methods for achieving your goal.

Features of the game
A development system based on points and upgrades. Experiments with physics and interaction of balls. Exploring the laboratory with gradual revelation of secrets. A variety of gameplay strategies thanks to combinations of mechanics.

24827.description:
Swarmdustry is a strategy game about building a factory where, instead of the usual machines, pipes, and conveyors, a living organism develops. The swarm extracts resources, grows workers, and gradually transforms a small hive into a complex production system. Here, industry literally consists of flesh: buildings, creatures, and transport routes are interconnected and function as a single organism.

Development of live production

Initially, a significant portion of the work must be performed manually, but over time, manual labor gives way to automation. Different members of the Swarm are assigned specific duties: some mine materials, others handle transportation, others transfer energy, and certain species support construction and production. From these elements, branching chains can be created, connecting buildings with routes and gradually expanding the colony's scale.

Expansion requires not only resources but also thoughtful spatial organization. Some structures require energy, others use fuel, so the placement of energy structures and the movement of creatures within the network must be carefully considered. The Genetic Chamber opens up new possibilities for further development, and specialized construction creatures allow for the automatic construction of large sections of the base using pre-saved designs. At the same time, enemy factions are present on the planet, forcing the defense of existing infrastructure and consideration of threats during further expansion.

Features of the game

A living factory made of organic buildings. Different types of workers with their own tasks. Genetic enhancements for the development of the Swarm. Automatic construction of large structures.
